product_metadata.title: MSC International Joie Oink Plastic Pig Microwave Plate Lid Cover, 26.035x26.035x8.89 cm, Pink
features: Cleaner kitchen – keep your microwave clean with this cute piggy cover. Fits over any plate of food to ensure it doesn't splatter around your microwave.
Reduce waste – you no longer need to use paper towels, napkins, or other wraps to cover Food splatter.
Ventilation holes – allows steam to release evenly, prevents condensation, and keeps food moist but not soggy.
Household essential – a necessary accessory for cooking and reheating leftovers. A must-have for college students.
Care instructions – easy to clean. Hand wash with Warm, soapy water.
description: This little Piggy keeps the microwave sparkly clean! An amazing splatter guard that works for reheating leftovers and easy meals on the go. The built-in steam vents help heat food evenly. Can be stored in the microwave, so it is out of the way and always ready for use.
